allowed_interpretation: Counter-observation to a HIF-selective programme in WWOX-partial-loss brain; transcript pattern compatible with an activity/seizure-linked metabolic programme (H-act) and glial composition (H-glia); no HIF protein, hydroxylation, lactate, oxygen condition, per-animal seizure record or age covariate exists

expected_effect_on_generation: Narrow the Q2 HIF hypothesis to the organoid (H-org) vs activity (H-act) vs composition (H-glia) split; lower weight on any lever whose only rationale is 'reverse the hypoxia/glycolysis signature'
